rationale: NBU instant-payments estate is a recurring first-party rail source for adoption and participant data.
SEP/ISO 20022 section is the primary, continuously updated national credit-transfer infrastructure source.
Recurring annual oversight report series with structured payment-system statistics; monitor the series, not just the 2019 PDF.
First-party scheme newsroom; low Ukraine cadence but the only direct UnionPay record.
Single NBU press release on PROSTIR-UnionPay co-badging; evidence artifact under the NBU news hub.
NABU association publications are high-value on interchange, but site fetch failed/rate-limited; recheck liveness.
Rada bill tracker gives dated primary status on interchange/acquiring legislation.
Regularly updated cross-country interchange compilation including Ukraine; good benchmarking series.
Ukrainian EBA root duplicates the EN committee/survey entry already kept (c_263).
Wikipedia PROSTIR page is a one-time actor-map and footnote-trail mine, not a monitored source.
AUB bank-by-bank indicator tables are a recurring association statistics series for market-share work.
Member register to mine once for a bank seed list; fetch failed, recheck before mining.
Associate-member list maps vendors/processors/ATM-POS suppliers; mine once after liveness recheck.
EMA member register is the densest cashless-ecosystem actor map; mine once (logo-gallery attribute extraction).
EMA AntiFraud HUB produces recurring association-only fraud and transaction statistics.
Second banking association with thin, unverified publishing footprint; recheck reachability and value.
RAU Analytics gives recurring merchant-side retail survey data underpinning POS/acquiring demand.
Single event write-up on the RAU domain already covered by the analytics feed; fetch failed.
State-portal mirror of the UAFIC fintech catalogue; use once as a fetch-friendly route to association research.
EBA recurring bilingual finance/payment-terms member surveys are a credible business-side series.
Single co-published survey landing page; useful as an alternative retrieval path for that study.
Marketing association is mainly a one-time pointer to research-agency supply side; little payments output.
Shopping-centre council gives indirect physical-acceptance backdrop; value to payments cell unproven.
Wikipedia stub on a supplier association; low credibility and only tangential B2B payment-terms relevance.
Non-bank finance association fills a real licensing gap but publishes only via a thin Facebook page.
ATMIA Europe substitutes for the missing domestic ATM body, but its reports/member data are membership-gated.
Single Minfin article relaying an association position; the aggregator media outlets are covered elsewhere.
